hints.title: Filter Conditions
hints.text: Keep only restaurants meeting veganFriendly criteria (if veganFriendly is 1, restaurant must be 1), price <= maxPrice, and distance <= maxDistance.

hints.title: Extract Matching Elements
hints.text: Filter the list of restaurants against all three criteria into an eligible candidate list.

hints.title: Sort by Rating then ID
hints.text: Sort eligible candidates descending by rating. Break ties by descending restaurant id.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Filtering without stable or proper tie-breaker comparator leads to incorrect ordering.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear filter followed by standard comparison sort runs well within limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles combined filtering predicates and compound sort comparator cleanly.
complexity.notes: Each restaurant row is [id, rating, veganFriendly, price, distance].
